llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses VLC's default snapshot naming pattern 'vlcsnap-*.png' and default save location '/home/user/Pictures/', which precisely matches the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly checks snapshot_count >= min_count (1), confirming at least one VLC snapshot was saved to the Pictures folder.
Negative-control resistant: setup only downloads the video and launches VLC without taking any snapshot, so the initial state correctly yields 0 files and fails the check.
The evaluator handles the getter output safely with type checking and ValueError fallback, ensuring robustness at runtime.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If multiple evaluation runs occur in the same environment session, pre-existing vlcsnap files could cause a false positive. Consider recording the file count before the task and checking the delta, though this is unlikely to matter given the base_setup snapshot isolation.
